description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductReviewDao interface, providing database access methods for product review entities, including queries to retrieve reviews by customer, product, and combinations thereof, using QueryDSL with JPA.

classes.name: ProductReviewDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for data access of product reviews, extending generic DAO and providing specific query methods for reviews based on customer and product.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews submitted by a specific customer, including associated product and descriptions.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Fetches reviews associated with a specific product, including customer details and descriptive information.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a single review for a specific product and customer combination.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Fetches product reviews for a product filtered by language, including customer and description details.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product review by its unique identifier.
